subject.title: test telegram rich model browse channel data

question: Should this focused standalone regression test be accepted as an exception to the normal policy against test-only PRs?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and protects a visible Telegram contract, but it does not accompany a runtime fix, new behavior, linked bug, or recorded owner request.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Accept the focused coverage once the contributor supplies redacted Telegram evidence showing the button and callback path.

options.title: Close as test-only
options.body: Decline the standalone test and carry equivalent coverage in the next runtime change that modifies this directive or Telegram browse path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the focused coverage once the contributor supplies redacted Telegram evidence showing the button and callback path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both this directive test and the generic channel seam whose ownership boundary determines whether the test belongs here.
